text: AI Show and Tell - New York (Global AI New York), Mon 2026-09-21 6-9pm, Microsoft Research Lab, 300 Lafayette St. Agents are easy to demo. Running them is the hard part: evaluating agents, governing them, and running a team of them in production. Three talks, real systems, real failure modes. 7:00 'Your New Teammates: Architecting a Multi-Agent Workforce' (Henk Boelman) - inside hamba.nl, a live Dutch travel magazine run by seven Foundry-hosted agents covering the full editorial pipeline. 7:30 'From Findings to Fixes: How SCOPE and Azure Cosmos DB Improved AI-Generated Apps' (Jay Gordon, Cedric Vidal). 8:00 'From Intent to Enforcement: Open-Source Evaluation and Governance for AI Agents' (Mehrnoosh Sameki).
